integrity: The exact finite-volume results are proved by local stability and transfer-matrix characteristic polynomial. Gaussian asymptotics use analytic cumulants. Finite exhaustive verification is a check, not the infinite proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite simple circular two-leg ladders with n>=3 and integer q>=3, J>0; no neutral-energy moves are allowed in the definition of strictly frozen. Does not calculate dynamic reachability or a thermodynamic Gibbs distribution; n tends to infinity only for fixed q. Prior specialized finite-width enumeration literature may contain an equivalent formulation.
title: Exact frozen-state energy law for multicolor ferromagnetic Potts ladders
